Services

Our Services

Three levels, from a 90-minute starting point to ongoing governance support. Fixed scope, fixed price, no surprises.

Where to start

You do not have to begin with a full assessment. Most organisations start with the Readiness Check, and the fee is credited back if they go further.

  1. Step 1 AI Act Readiness Check €450 3 business days The starting point. Find out whether and how the regulation applies to you.
  2. Step 2 AI Risk Assessment €2,500 5 business days The full engagement. Obligations mapped, gaps identified, actions prioritised.
  3. Step 2+ Assessment + Security Deep-Dive €3,200 5 business days The assessment plus a technical security review of your AI systems.
  4. Step 3 Governance Retainer On request Ongoing, monthly Continuous monitoring, regulatory updates, and support when you are audited.

Step one

Not ready for a full assessment?

The AI Act Readiness Check is €450: a 90-minute session and a five-page document covering your AI system inventory, a preliminary risk categorisation, and the first three actions to take. Delivered in 3 business days. If you go on to a full assessment within 60 days, the fee is deducted in full.

See the Readiness Check

AI Readiness Assessment

A complete audit of your AI systems, EU AI Act obligations, data governance risks, and vendor exposure — delivered in five business days.

€2,500 fixed price, no additional fees
  • ✓ AI System Inventory — complete register with EU AI Act risk classification
  • ✓ EU AI Act Gap Analysis — obligations mapped, gaps identified, applicable articles cited
  • ✓ Data Governance Review — how personal data is handled by AI systems against GDPR
  • ✓ Vendor Risk Assessment — contracts and data processing agreements reviewed
  • ✓ Internal Policy Review — whether an AI use policy exists and whether it is adequate
  • ✓ Prioritised Action Plan — immediate, 30-day, and 90-day actions ranked by risk
  • ✓ Executive Briefing Call — 30-minute walkthrough with key stakeholders

Delivered in 5 business days from scoping call

Step three

Governance Retainer

An assessment tells you where you stand on one day. Regulation moves, and so does your AI estate — teams adopt new tools, vendors change their terms, guidance is published. The retainer keeps the picture current instead of letting it expire.

  • ✓Quarterly governance review — progress against your action plan, tracked and documented.
  • ✓Regulatory monitoring — we tell you when something changes that affects your systems, rather than you finding out from the news.
  • ✓Re-assessment of new AI systems as you adopt them, so the inventory does not go stale.
  • ✓Named contact for AI governance questions between reviews.
  • ✓Support during audits, customer security reviews, and due diligence requests.

Priced on request

Scoped to the size of your AI estate and billed monthly. Available after an assessment, so the scope is based on findings rather than guesswork.

Ask about the retainer

Optional follow-up services

After an initial assessment, clients may need further support. These are available separately — not bundled into the primary offer.

  • AI Use Policy Drafting

    We write your internal AI governance policy based on assessment findings. Priced on request.

  • Quarterly Governance Review

    A lighter-touch quarterly check-in to track progress and flag regulatory changes. Retainer-based. Priced on request.

  • Vendor Due Diligence

    A one-off review of a specific AI product your organisation is considering purchasing. Priced on request.

  • EU AI Act Technical Documentation

    Preparation of required technical documentation for high-risk AI systems. Scoped individually. Priced on request.

This is right for your organisation if…

  • → You are using AI tools but have no formal policy governing their use.
  • → You are unsure whether your AI systems trigger obligations under the EU AI Act.
  • → You process customer, employee, or financial data through AI platforms.
  • → Legal, compliance, or leadership is asking about AI risk and you need a clear answer.
  • → You have a customer-facing AI product and want compliance confidence before you scale.
  • → You want to get ahead of regulatory scrutiny rather than react to it.

Not sure which tier is right?

Book a free 20-minute discovery call. We'll confirm what's in scope and which tier fits your situation — at no cost and with no obligation.
